## Public technical-proof safety gate

- [ ] The change improves a real, inspectable engineering or documentation asset.
- [ ] No client data, credentials, private URLs, production configuration, customer record, or proprietary customer workflow is included.
- [ ] Claims are accurate, reproducible, and do not imply customer results or production deployment.
- [ ] Tests, static checks, build, formatting, and relevant documentation have been updated.
- [ ] The synthetic-data and operational-boundary statements remain accurate.
